'''2002 Coruscant Regionals''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG regional in 2002. [[Chris Wodicka]] finished 6th (out of 36) with a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list (''6th place Coruscant regionals'').<ref name="dt-23830">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830 6th place Coruscant regionals], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 8 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23830/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23830/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009115058/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' June 2002
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Players:''' 36<ref name="tr-d3692" />
* '''Site:''' Dark Tower Games, Denville<ref name="tr-d3695" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Chris Wodicka's report dates the regional 26 May 2002 (the hub says June 2002), which is before the Players Committee's Virtual Set 2 took effect on 1 June 2002; the hub's format, Premiere - Original VS2, would then be Premiere - Original VS1.<ref name="tr-d3692" />
* Michael Robinson's report dates the regional 26 May 2002 (title '5-26', posted 27 May), but the hub gives June 2002 and the format Premiere - Original VS2, which took effect on 1 June 2002.<ref name="tr-d3695" />
